Definition: Ezer, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Ezer is a name carried by four different men, and two of them are named in the verses here. In 1 Chronicles 4:4 he is Ezer the father of Hushah, among the sons of Hur, and in Nehemiah 12:42 he is one of the singers who sang loud at the dedication of the wall. The name means help, and each of these men carries it in a different generation.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name can be a small sermon. Every Ezer in the record carries the word for help, and I take that as a reminder that God raises up helpers in every generation, whether they are fathers, singers, or men whose names we nearly pass over.
